items.title: Automate Custom Image Builds with EC2 Image Builder for Amazon WorkSpaces
items.summary: Introduction For organizations running Amazon WorkSpaces at scale, a custom image is the foundation of every end user session. Often called a golden image, it defines the operating system configuration, security posture and installed applications. It shapes the user experience that employees interact with every day.
